children.content: This package carries no code. It declares what is on screen and what it may do; the browser decides how to draw it and whether to allow it. Copy this directory to start your own app.
Every component kind in spec 0.1 appears below, so you can see each one rendered before you use it.
This app is signed by the DEMO key, which is published in this repository. Anyone can forge a package signed by it. A signature proves the bytes were not changed — it does not prove who wrote them.

"Delete everything" is deliberately NOT declared in the manifest. Press it: the browser refuses and says so. An action that is not in the signed manifest cannot run, which is what stops a tampered screen from inventing one.
